releaseNotes: Platform release: a founder whose company has been running a launch outside Formation can bring that record in. The engine reads its own launch workspace — PROJECT_STATE.yaml, the launch trace, lane evidence, and Markdown artifacts — through one read-only CLI that opens no handle for writing, so an import cannot change the workspace it reads and the engine can keep running it afterwards, unchanged. What arrives is explicitly a draft: recorded lane completions become recommendations to confirm, open questions become questions, founder verdicts become decisions with the dates they were made, blockers become work, and documents become draft deliverables with an immutable first version. Nothing becomes a fact.

Preview and apply are one computation, so the founder is never shown a rehearsal that differs from the performance, and a second import of an unchanged workspace creates nothing. A founder's own words are never replaced: an empty company field is filled, a field the two records disagree on becomes a question quoting both, and a deliverable the founder has edited is flagged as having drifted from its source rather than overwritten. The workspace's own contradictions — evidence a finished lane names but does not have, work finished over an unfinished dependency, a state the workspace itself says is unreconciled — are reported above what would arrive and survive as open questions. Requests name a source id, never a path, and an id resolves only by matching a launch workspace the server actually holds. Checks, 118 domain tests, 24 engine fixtures, the production build, and the full audit pass.
